correctness.rationale: The canonical six-total bijection and pairwise incidence convert the complex into the clique complex of L(K_6); the star cover has nerve K_6, and its complement comprises precisely twenty triangular 2-cells. The pair long exact sequence identifies integral H2 with the kernel of the simplicial triangle boundary, exactly exterior cube of the rank-five augmentation lattice (free of rank ten), with all other reduced integral homology zero. Orientation action is verified for all 720 permutations. Rational character equality is confirmed on all eleven conjugacy classes, and direct 10-by-10 integral minor matrices give distinct mod-two transposition ranks 4 versus 3. Standalone standard-library finite verifier and deterministic saved output supplied; modular ranks are corroborative, not an integral proof.

value.rationale: The two relevant ten-dimensional representations are naturally motivated by the exceptional S6 action on the six one-factorizations and the standard S6 action on original labels; rational character theory identifies them, while integral equivariance distinguishes them sharply. The 4-versus-3 mod-two obstruction resolves a genuine lift-to-integers ambiguity that Betti numbers and rational traces cannot settle, and supplies a compact test case for arithmetic equivariant homology.
